For nurses, HCAs and support workers

Care work on your terms.

Agency work means you choose when you work. Register once, then take the shifts that fit around your family, your studies or your other job.

Register now Roles we recruit

Already registered? Log in to your worker portal

Who we are looking for

  • Healthcare assistants
  • Support workers
  • Registered nurses (RGN, RMN, RNLD)
  • Senior carers and team leaders

Most roles need at least 6 months of paid care experience in the UK.

What agency work with us looks like

Why care workers register with us.

You choose your shifts

Accept the work that suits you and say no to the rest.

Work near home

We offer shifts based on your postcode and how you travel.

A consultant you can call

One person who knows you, your skills and the work you want.

Weekly pay

Paid every week for the hours on your signed timesheets.

Free mandatory training

Including Basic Life Support, at no cost to you.

Free uniform

Given to you before your first shift.

Help with your DBS

We guide you through the application.

Refer a friend

A bonus when someone you refer completes their qualifying hours. Ask us for the scheme rules.

How to join

Five steps to your first shift.

  1. Register online

    A short form. About five minutes.

  2. Talk to a consultant

    About your experience and the work you want.

  3. Apply in our portal

    Full application and documents, uploaded online.

  4. Pre-employment checks

    Including right to work and a criminal record check. The law requires both for care work.

  5. Pick your shifts

    Once checks are complete we start offering you work.

We never charge you to find you work. UK law does not allow employment agencies to charge work-seekers for finding them jobs. No fees for registration, jobs or visa sponsorship. If anyone asks you for money in our name, do not pay and email info@aviteushealthcare.co.uk.

Questions

Questions from care workers.

How long does it take to start?

It depends mostly on how fast your checks come back. Getting your documents ready before you apply is the best way to speed things up.

Do I have to accept every shift I am offered?

No. You choose which shifts to accept.

Can I work for Aviteus alongside another job?

Yes, as long as your other contract allows it. Many agency workers pick up extra shifts this way.

Will I get written terms?

Yes. Before you start, you will receive your terms in writing and a key information document. It explains who pays you, how much and any deductions.
